Accepts postcode + house number or free text. Sources: BAG, CBS, Leefbaarometer.

tools.name: nl_home_compare
tools.description: Use when the user is choosing between 2 to 5 Dutch addresses: side-by-side liveability, crime, home values, floor area, year built, noise, air quality, ground height and distances to station, supermarket, school and GP, with the best address per metric and the full report for each. tools.description: Use when the user asks what a Dutch neighbourhood or postcode area is like: residents and age mix, housing and home values, household income, energy use, distances to 18 amenities, police-registered crime vs national rate and liveability score, in English. Input: any postcode or CBS buurt code. Sour

tools.name: nl_address_lookup
tools.description: Use when you need to check that a Dutch address exists or get its exact spelling and coordinates: official BAG address from postcode + house number or free text, latitude/longitude, BAG ids, municipality, province and CBS neighbourhood code. Cheap address validation for onboarding, delivery and CRM.

tools.name: nl_address_reverse
tools.description: Use when you have coordinates in the Netherlands and need the address: nearest official BAG address with distance in metres, postcode, city, municipality, province, BAG ids and CBS buurt and wijk codes, plus other nearby addresses. Input: WGS84 latitude and longitude. Source: Kadaster BAG via PDOK.

tools.name: nl_energy_label
tools.description: Use when the user asks for the energy label of a Dutch home: the officially registered label (A++++ to G), registration and expiry date, building type and energy index, or a clear 'none registered'. Input: postcode + house number. Source: RVO EP-Online, the Dutch national register. Costs 0.005 USDC

tools.name: nl_crime
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a Dutch neighbourhood or postcode is safe: police-registered crime per 1,000 residents vs the national rate, split into burglary, bicycle theft, vehicle crime, violence and vandalism, with counts and a ratio. Input: Dutch postcode or CBS buurt code. Source: Politie ope

tools.name: nl_postcode_addresses
tools.description: Use when you need every address in a Dutch postcode: street, house number, letter and addition, BAG id and coordinates, sorted. For address pickers, delivery and canvassing routes and data cleaning. Source: Kadaster BAG via PDOK. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402, or 3 credits of a Factline API key.

tools.name: nl_address_batch
tools.description: Use when enriching a list of Dutch addresses (up to 10 per call, 0.0015 USDC each): official BAG address and coordinates, CBS neighbourhood, liveability percentile, crime per 1,000 residents vs national, average home value and optionally the energy label.
